intended_utility: market-neutral alpha sleeve, not a standalone SPY challenger
evidence_strength: mechanism-backed but exact threshold and horizon are implementation choices

signal.signal_prices: fully closed 23:30-00:00 UTC spot and perpetual kline closes
signal.threshold: strictly above zero and strictly above the 90th percentile of the 90 immediately preceding available daily basis observations

trade.entry: 00:30 UTC open of both spot and perpetual klines
trade.exit: 07:30 UTC open of both spot and perpetual klines
trade.legs: long spot and short equal-notional perpetual
trade.leverage: none beyond collateralized short margin; no liquidation benefit assumed
trade.capital_return: 0.5 * spot simple return + 0.5 * perpetual short simple return
trade.funding_guard: exclude if an actual funding calc_time is in (entry, exit]
trade.missing_data: skip any day missing a signal, entry, or exit boundary on either leg

costs.explanation: four executions weighted by 0.5 capital per leg; subtract once on triggered days

holdout_policy: Evaluate development first. If any gate fails, stop without opening later partitions. Do not alter quantile/lookback, clocks, holding period, weights, costs, basis definition, add OI/funding/volume filters, invert the trade, add ML, or switch venues/coins on consumed data.
